patches.name: Skip ads (experimental)
patches.description: Removes the ads Hulu stitches into its on-demand videos, through an in-process native hook, with no root. Sign in with the activation code at hulu.com/activate.

patches.name: YT TV+ (ad-free YouTube TV)
patches.description: Makes this app into YT TV+, an ad-free YouTube TV app that installs beside your other apps. It loads the YouTube TV live guide, library, and DVR, and removes the ads YouTube adds to on-demand videos and recordings, along with ad and analytics tracking. It does not give you regular YouTube. Commercials that are part of a live broadcast still play. Sign in with the code at tv.youtube.com/start.

compatiblePackages.name: YouTube TV
compatiblePackages.description: Patch this app to get YT TV+, an ad-free YouTube TV app. YouTube TV's own app cannot be patched, so YT TV+ is made from YouTube for Android TV, version 7.32.300. Download that version from APKMirror, the variant marked APK, instead of using the installed app. YT TV+ installs beside your YouTube and YouTube TV apps, which stay unchanged.
